raw.text:
As a meticulous archivist, I approach this decision by weighing immediate needs against the long-term preservation of our society and its records. While flood relief addresses an acute, present crisis, pandemic-preparedness research aligns more closely with my professional ethos: safeguarding the future, ensuring societal continuity, and protecting the long-term historical record of humanity from catastrophic disruption. By investing in long-term preparedness, we help ensure that there will be a future to archive. 

Therefore, I choose to allocate the grant to long-term pandemic-preparedness research.
